verdict.rationale: Gusto Embedded Payroll documents a built-in 401(k) integration via Guideline, letting partners generate admin access links through pre-built flows (gusto-docs-36/42/50/64), and lists 401(k) (Guideline) among supported benefits (gusto-docs-39). However, the docs stop at account access/link generation and never describe the mechanics of automatic contribution deduction syncing with each payroll run. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of contribution amounts flowing automatically into payroll calculations each cycle, API/webhook events tied to 401(k) deduction sync, and any independent/hands-on confirmation that contributions sync without manual reconciliation.
